flavor: A pale, bloated 僵尸 sits amidst a pile of rotting scrolls, its eyes milky and vacant. It offers to recite a lost verse of ancient power, but its voice sounds like dry parchment scraping against stone. It demands a portion of your vitality to fuel its fleeting inspiration.
name: The Scholar's Hollowed Pact
reason: The party encounters a scholarly undead entity offering a trade of essence for knowledge.
